ki tarhi ? sāmagrīsvarūpasya kārakasākalyasyaiva; tacca pramātṛprameyasadbhāve saṃpadyate
ataḥ sāmagryekadeśakārakasadbhāve'pi kāryasyānutpatteḥ naikadeśasya karaṇatā, sāmagrīsadbhāvetu tasyāvaśyaṃbhāvenotpatteḥ tasyā eva sannipatyajanakatvena sādhakatamatvādupapannaṃ karaṇatvam
karaṇaṃ ca pramāṇam, karaṇasādhanatvāt pramāṇaśabdasya
na ca sākalyavyatirekeṇa kārakāntare sādhakatamatvaṃ saṃbhāvayituṃ śakyam
yadi hi tadvyatirekeṇāsakalāvasthāyāmapi kvacitkārake pramitiravakalpyeta, syāttatrāpi sādhakatamatvātkaraṇatvam, na cāsau tatrāvakalpyate pratītivirodhāt, tasmāt sākalyameva karaṇam
avyabhicāriṇīmasandigdhāmarthopalabdhiṃ vidadhatī bodhā'bodhasvabhāvā sāmagrī pramāṇam
bodhā'bodhasvabhāvā hi tasya svarūpam, avyabhicārādiviśeṣaṇārthopalabdhisādhanatvaṃ lakṣaṇam
nyāyamaṃ॰ pṛ॰ 12
–ṇābhyu– bhā॰
yata eva sādhakatamaṃ karaṇaṃ karaṇasādhanaśca pramāṇaśabdaḥ, tata eva sāmagryāḥ pramāṇatvaṃ yuktam, tadvyatirekeṇa kārakāntare kvacidapi tamabarthasaṃsparśā'nupapatteḥ
anekakārakasannidhāne kārya ghaṭamānam anyataravyapagame ca vighaṭamānaṃ kasmai atiśayaṃ prayacchet
na ca atiśayaḥ kāryajanmani kasyacidavadhāryate sarveṣāṃ tatra vyāpriyamāṇatvātsa ca sāmagryantargatasya na kasyacidekasya kārakasya kathayituṃ pāryate
sāmagryāstu so'tiśaya suvaca, sannihitā cet sāmagrī saṃpannameva phalam iti saiva atiśayavatī
nyāyamaṃ॰ pṛ॰ 13
nanu karaṇaṃ kartṛkarmāpekṣaṃ bhavati, kartṛkarmaṇośca sāmagryantaḥ–patitayoḥ svarūpapracyutitaḥ asaṃbhavāt kathaṃ tadapekṣaṃ sākalyasya karaṇatvamiti ? tadavicāritaramaṇīyam; sākalyāntargata kārakāpekṣayaivāsya karaṇatvopapatteḥ
sākalyaṃ hi nāma kārakāṇāṃ dharma, na ca svakīyo dharmaḥ svasyaiva svarūpāpahārāya prabhavati, sākalyāvasthāyāmapi kārakasvarūpasya pratyabhijñāyamānatvācca na tatraiṣāṃ svarūpapracyutiḥ, tasmāttadantargatakārakāpekṣayā labdhakaraṇabhāvaṃ sākalyaṃ pramāṇam, na tu jñānaṃ phalarūpatvāttasya
phalasya ca pramāṇatānupapannaiva; tato bhinnatvāttasya, pramīyate hi yenārthaḥ tatpramāṇam iti karaṇasādhane pramāṇaśabdavyutpādanāt karaṇasyaiva tadrūpatopapannā
atha vyatiriktaphalajanakamapi jñānameva pramāṇamucyate; tadayuktam; sakalalokāṅgīkṛta-ajñānasvabhāvasya śabdaliṅgāderapramāṇatā prasaṅgāt
tato jñānamapi sāmagryanupraviṣṭameva, viśeṣaṇajñānamiva viśeṣyapratyakṣe, liṅgajñānamiva liṅgipratītau, sārūpyadarśanamiva upamāne, śabdajñānamiva tadarthajñāne, pramāṇatvaṃ pratipadyate
tasmāt bodhābodhasvabhāvaṃ kārakasākalyaṃ pramāṇam ityayameva pakṣaḥ pramāṇopapanna iti
yattu kimapekṣaṃ sāmagryāḥ karaṇatvam iti, tadantargatakārakāpekṣam iti vrūma
kārakāṇāṃ dharma sāmagrī na svarūpahānāya teṣāṃ kalpate sākalyadaśāyāmapi tatsvarūpapratyabhijñānāttasmāt antargatakārakāpekṣayā labdhakaraṇabhāvā sāmagrī pramāṇam

tatsadbhāve'pyeṣāmanutpattau na kadācidapyatastadutpattiḥ ityakhilaṃ jagat pramāṇavikalamāpadyeta

tathāhi–jñātṛvyāpāraḥ svaviṣayaṃ vijñānamaparajñātṛvyāpārasahakṛta evotpādayati, karmatayā svaviṣayavijñānotpādakatvāt, ghaṭādivat

etena dvitīyapakṣopyapāsta; pratipāditadoṣāṇāṃ tatrāpyanuṣaṅgā'viśeṣāt

kiñca, deśāpekṣayā yad dūratvaṃ śabdasya tat ki deśagrahaṇe sati syāt, asati vā ? na tāvadasati; viśeṣaṇatvāt, yad viśeṣaṇaṃ tad gṛhītameva viśeṣye viśiṣṭapratipattinimittam yathā daṇḍādi, viśeṣaṇañca śabdasya dūrādipratipattau deśa iti
tathā, śabde dūrādipratyayo dūradeśādigrahaṇe satyeva bhavati tatsāpekṣadūrādipratyayatvāt, yastatsāpekṣadūrādipratyayaḥ sa tadgrahaṇe satyeva bhavati yathā pādapādau dūrādipratyayaḥ, tatsāpekṣadūrādipratyayaścāyam, tasmāttadgrahaṇe satyeva bhavatīti
suprasiddho hi dūrāsannapādapādau cakṣuṣā dūrāsannadeśagrahaṇe satyeva dūrāsannavyavahāraḥ, ataḥ śabde'pyasau tadgrahaṇe satyeva iṣyatām
tatheṣṭau ca kutastadgrahaṇam–ki śrotrāt, anyato vā ? yadi śrotrāt; deśasyāpi śabdatvaprasaṅgaḥ tallakṣaṇatvāttasya
indriyāntareṇa tatprattipattau sāṅgatyābhāvāt na deśāpekṣayā dūraḥ śabdaḥ iti pratītiḥ syāt
na hi devadattagṛhītadūradeśāpekṣayā yajñadattasya dūra śabdaḥ iti pratītirdṛṣṭā
atha indriyadvayānubhavānantara bhāvini vikalpajñāne tathāpratīterayamadoṣaḥ; tarhi pūrvaṃ dūrādirahitasya pratītiḥ punastatsahitasya iti krameṇa tatpratītiḥ syāt, na caivam, prathamameva dūratvādiviśiṣṭasyāsya pratīte
tato gatipariṇatasya svayaṃ dūrādipratyayayogyatāviśiṣṭasya gandhasyeva śabdasyāpi dūrādipratyayagocaratvaṃ pratipattavyam, iti siddhaṃ prāpyakāritvaṃ śrotrasya, kathamanyathā tadviṣaye deśādisandeha syād rūpavat ? yathaiva hi rūpe pratīyamāne kimasmin deśe rūpametat pratibhāti anyasmin vā, asyāṃ diśi anyasyāṃ vā iti na sandehaḥ, niyatadigdeśatayaiva asya aprāpyakāriṇendriyeṇa pratipattisaṃbhavāt, tathā atrāpyasau na syāt, asti cātrasandeha–kimanta śabdo'yaṃ jāta bahirvā prācyāṃ diśi anyasyāṃ vā iti
atha deśādisandehāt tatraivaṃ sandehaḥ tarhi gandho'pyaprāpta eva gṛhyatāṃ deśādisandehādevātrāpi sandehasaṃbhavāt
atha ato ghrāṇavikāradarśanāt prāpto'sau pratīyate, tadetacchabde'pi samam, śrotravikārasya bādhiryāde śabdāt pratīte
tasmād indriyānindriyābhyāmanyasya gauṇapratyakṣaṃ pratyasādhāraṇakāraṇatvānupapatteḥ sūktam–sāṃvyavahārikamindriyānindriyapratyakṣam iti

parataścet viruddham, tathāvabhāsamānatvasya jaḍatve satyeva saṃbhavāt, svasiddhau paramukhaprekṣitvalakṣaṇatvājjaḍatvasya
yad yenopalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptenākāreṇa na pratibhāsate na tat tadātmakam yathā ghaṭākāreṇa paṭaḥ, na pratibhāsate ca jñānākāreṇa ghaṭādyarthaḥ ityanumānācca ghaṭāderjaḍatvaprasiddheḥ anumānabādhitapakṣanirdeśānantaraṃ prayuktatvena kālātyayāpadiṣṭatvam

na ca vijñānarūpatayā arthasattvamiṣṭameva ityabhidhātavyam; vijñānavyatiriktasyaivāsya pratibhāsamānatvāt
tathā ca, yad yatropalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptaṃ sannopalabhyate tattatra nāsti yathā kvacitpradeśaviśeṣe ghaṭaḥ, nopalabhyate ca upalabhyamāne ghaṭādau tathābhūtaṃ jñānasvarūpamiti

tataśca yo viruddharūpānubhavo nāsau ekasvarūpārthaviṣayaḥ yathā sukha-duḥkhānubhava, asti ca artha-jñānayoḥ parasparaparihārasthitasvarūpatvena viruddhayoḥ svarūpānubhava iti
grāhakasvarūpaṃ hi vijñānamantaḥ grāhyasvarūpaṃ tu nīlādikaṃ bahiḥ parisphuṭaṃ prati bhāsate, tathāpi anayorabhede na kiñcit kutaścidbhidyeta, pratibhāsabhedaṃ viruddhadharmādhyāsañca vihāya anyasya bhedakasyā'saṃbhavāt
tathā, yad dvayākāratayā pratibhāsate tat tattvato bhinnam yathā sukhaduḥkhe, dvayākāratayā pratibhāsete ca viṣaya-jñānākārau ityanumānāccānayorbheda
abhede vā jñānarūpāgrahaṇe nīlāderapyagrahaṇaprasaṅga, yādṛśaṃ hi pāramārthikaṃ yasya rūpaṃ tasyāgrahaṇe tadapi na gṛhyate yathā pītasya pītarūpāgrahaṇe pītam, na gṛhyate ca jñānasvarūpaṃ nīlāderiti
nanu prakāśavyatiriktasya nīlāderūpalambhe syādetat, na cāsau tadvyatirikta kadācidapyupalabhyate, tadayuktam; yata ko'yaṃ prakāśo nāma aham iti buddhiḥ, nīlāderdṛśyatā vā ? prathamapakṣe siddho nīlādestato bheda, na hi bhinnamupalabhyamānameva abhinna yuktam sukhadu khāderapyabhedāpatte

kiñca, prameyāt pūrvakālabhāvijñānaṃ tadvyavasthāpakaṃ syāt, uttarakālabhāvi vā ? prathamapakṣe kathamasyendriyārthasannikarṣaprabhavatā prameyamantareṇaivotpadyamānatvāt ? yatprameyamantareṇaivotpadyate na tadindriyārthasannikarṣajam yathā khapuṣpavijñānam, prameyamantareṇaivotpadyate ca prameyāt pūrvakālabhāvi tadvyavasthāpakatvenābhimataṃ jñānamiti
dvitīyapakṣe tu pramāṇāt pūrvakālavṛttitvaṃ prameyasya kutaścit pratipannam, na vā ? yadi na pratipannam; kathaṃ sadvyavahāraviṣayaḥ ? yat kutaścinna pratipannam na tat sadvyavahāraviṣayaḥ yathā gaganendīvaram, kutaścidapratipannañca pramāṇātpūrvakālavṛttitvaṃ prameyasyeti
atha pratipannam; kiṃ svataḥ, parato vā ? yadi svataḥ; kathamasya jñānādbhedaḥ tasyaiva svato'vabhāsalakṣaṇatvāt ? yat svataḥ prasiddham na tajjñānādbhidyate yathā jñānasvarūpam, svataḥ prasiddhañca jñānātpūrvaṃ pravartamānaṃ prameyatvenābhimataṃ vastviti
atha parataḥ; tanna; pramāṇād vyatiriktasya prameyavyavasthāhetoḥ parasyā'saṃbhavāt
atha pramāṇameva tasya tadvṛttitvaṃ prakāśayati; tanna; tasya svayaṃ tatkāle'sataḥ tatprakāśakatvā'yogāt, yad yatkāle nāsti na tattasya prakāśakam yathā svotpādātpūrvakālavṛttipadārthakāle'san pradīpo na tatprakāśakaḥ, nāsti ca pūrvakālaviśiṣṭasya prameyasya kāle jñānamiti
samakālatve tu jñānajñeyayoḥ savyetaragoviṣāṇavat grāhyagrāhakabhāvābhāvaḥ, na ca jñāne nīlādyākārānurāgapratītyanyathānupapattyā tadanurañjako bahirarthopyastītyabhidhātavyam; svapnāvasthāyāṃ tadabhāve'pi tadanurāgapratīteḥ, na hi taddaśābhāvini karituragādipratyaye'nurañjako bahirartho'sti, svapnetarapratyayānāmaviśeṣaprasaṅgāt

kiñca, sakalapramāṇāpekṣayā jñānasya karmatvā'prasiddhiḥ, svarūpā'pekṣayā vā ? yadi sakalapramāṇāpekṣayā; tadā sattvamapyasya atidurlabham; tathāhi–yat sarvapramāṇāpekṣayā karma na bhavati na tat sat yathā kharaviṣāṇam, sarvapramāṇāpekṣayā na bhavati ca karma vivakṣitaṃ pramāṇābhimataṃ jñānamiti
evaṃ pramāṇāntareṣvapyayameva nyāyaḥ ityakhilapramāṇānāmasattvaprasaṅge prameye kaḥ samāśvāsaḥ pramāṇanibandhanatvāt prameyavyavasthāyāḥ ? iti pūtkurvato'pi dvijasya sakalaśūnyatāpātaḥ syāt, taṃ parijihīrṣatā jñānasya apratyakṣatve'pi pramāṇāntarāt pratītirabhyupagantavyā iti karmatvenā'pratīyamānatvāt ityasyā'siddhatvam
astu nāma asya pramāṇāntarāt pratīyamānatvaṃ na tu karmatvam; iti cā'yuktam; pratīyamānasya akarmatvavirodhāt, pratīyamānatvaṃ hi grāhyatvamucyate, tadeva ca karmatvamiti

atha svarūpāpekṣayā karmatvā'prasiddhiḥ; tadapyanubhavaviruddhatvādayuktam; suprasiddho hi ghaṭagrāhijñānaviśiṣṭamātmānaṃ svato'hamanubhavāmi ityanubhava, tatprasiddhatvācca jñāne karmatvaprasiddhiriti ddheriti kathaṃ svarūpāpekṣayā tatra karmatvasyā'prasiddhi anubhavena na viruddhyate ? pratītisiddhasyāpyatra pratyakṣatvasya karmatvasya cā'pahnave arthe tatsadbhāve kaḥ samāśvāsaḥ iti kathaṃ tasya vyatirekadṛṣṭāntatā syāt ? prasaṅga-viparyayābhyāñcāsya pratyakṣatāsiddhiḥ; tathā hi– yat parokṣaṃ na tat svopadhānena anyamupalambhayati yathā indriyam, parokṣañca bhavadbhiḥ parikalpitaṃ jñānam iti prasaṅgaḥ
viparyayastu–yat svākāropahitam ākārāntaramupalambhayati tat parokṣaṃ na bhavati pratyakṣaṃ vā bhavati, yathā pradīpādyālokaḥ, upalambhayati ca jñānaṃ svākāropahitaṃ nīlādikam iti

atha prakāśatāmātram; tadapi jñānadharmaḥ, arthadharmaḥ, ubhayadharmaḥ, svatantraṃ vā syāt ? yadi jñānadharmaḥ; tarhi jñānaṃ prakāśate ityetāvadeva prāpnoti, na punaḥ arthaḥ prakāśate iti, anyadharmasya anyatra vyapadeśā'hetutvāt
yo yaddharmona bhavati na sa tatra tathā vyapadeśahetuḥ yathā paṭaraktatā rajate, na bhavati ca jñānadharmatayā prakāśamānatā arthasya dharmaḥ, tasmānna arthaḥ prakāśate iti vyapadeśaheturiti
atha arthadharmaḥ; sa ki sādhāraṇaḥ, asādhāraṇo vā ? prathamapakṣe sarvadā sarvān prati aviśeṣeṇaiva artho'vabhāseta na tu kadācit kañcana prati, prakāśarūpatāyāḥ sarvān pratyaviśiṣṭatvāt
na khalu pradīpaḥ prakāśarūpatāmāpannaḥ kiñcitprakāśate kiñcinna iti niyamo dṛṣṭaḥ
atha yadindriyeṇa upakṛtaḥ asādhāraṇataddharmo'rthaḥ sampannaḥ tasyaiva prakāśate nānyeṣām
nanu indriyāṇāṃ svārthaprakāśakajñānajananāt nā'paraṃ tadupakārakatvaṃ pratīyate, etacca tajjñānasya arthadharmatve sarvān prati aviśiṣṭam
na hi nīlatādyarthadharmaḥ yenaiva janyate tasyaiva prakāśate iti niyamo dṛṣṭaḥ

yatra hi yatsvarūpaṃ mukhyataḥ prasiddham tatra tat parā'napekṣam yathā vahnau bhāsurarūpoṣṇasparśasvarūpam, mukhyato'bhyupagamyate ca arthe prakāśamānatādharmaḥ, tasmāt jñānā'napekṣa eva syāt, na caivam, jñāne satyeva sarvadā tatra tatpratīteḥ
upacārataḥ tatra taddharmā'bhyupagame tu na kiñcidaniṣṭam, mukhyato hi prakāśamānatā jñānasya dharmaḥ, sā tadviṣayatvād arthe upacaryate

tathā, yatra sarvathā'bheda na tatra dharma-dharmibhāvaḥ yathā dharmadharmiṇoranyatarasvarūpe, sarvathā'bhedaśca dharma-dharmiṇorbhavadbhiriṣṭa iti

nanu ca ajñānanivṛtti jñānameva, na ca tadeva tasyaiva kārya yuktaṃ virodhāt, ataḥ kathamasyā pramāṇaphalatvaṃ syāt ? ityapyavicāritaramaṇīyam, yataḥ ajñānanivṛtteḥ svārthavyavasāyapariṇatilakṣaṇāyā svārthagrahaṇavyāpāralakṣaṇa-upayogarūpapramāṇena kāryatvā'virodhāt, sādhakatamāṃśasya itarāṃśāt kathañcidbhedapratipādanāt
kiñca, dharmarūpatām, dharmirūpatāṃ vā abhyupagamya ajñānanivṛttiḥ jñānameva ityabhyupagamyeta ? yadi dharmirūpatām, tatrāpi kimapekṣayā ajñānanivṛtte dharmitvaṃ parikalpyeta–jñānāpekṣayā, dharmāntarā'pekṣayā vā ? prathamapakṣe tannivṛtte dharmitvam, jñānasya tu dharmatvam iti vaiparītyamāyātam, na caitadyuktaṃ tasyāḥ tadāśritatvāt
yad yadāśritaṃ na tasya svāśrayāpekṣayaiva dharmitvaṃ dṛṣṭam yathā sukha-rūpāde, jñānāśritā ca ajñānanivṛttiḥ iti, ataḥ kathasyā dharmitvam ? niyamena asyā parāśritāyāḥ dharmasvabhāvatvasyaiva upapatteḥ tallakṣaṇatvāttasya
atha dharmāntarāpekṣayā; tadā jñānāpekṣayā kimasyā syāt ? dharmarūpatā cet; kathamevam jñānameva ajñānanivṛtti iti abhedā'bhidhānaṃ yujyate ? jñānasya ajñānanivṛttiḥ dharmaḥ iti bhedā'bhidhānasyaiva upapannatvāt, na khalu upacārādanyatra dharma-dharmiṇorabhedā'bhidhānaṃ yuktam atiprasaṅgāt

kiñca, asau kāryā, akāryā vā syāt ? yadi akāryā; sarvatra sarvadā sattvaprasaṅgāt sarva sarvadarśī syāt, deśādiniyatakāraṇādhīnatayā hi bhāvānāṃ deśādiniyamaḥ nānyathā
atha kāryā asau; kuto jāyeta–pramāṇābhimatajñānāt, anyato vā ? yadi anyataḥ; pramāṇābhimatajñānotpatteḥ prāguttarakālañca tadutpattiprasaktiḥ, na hi tadakāryasya tatsattākāle eva ātmalābho yuktaḥ
prayogaḥ–yad yadakāryaṃ na tad ātmalābhe tatsattāmapekṣate yathā ghaṭā'kāryaḥ paṭo nātmalābhe ghaṭasattām, pramāṇā'kāryā ca ajñānanivṛttiḥ anyata utpattimattvena iti

yadapyuktam–nityādisvabhāvasya manasaḥ sadbhāvasiddhistu yugapajjñānā'nutpattiliṅgāt ityādi; tadapyasamīkṣitābhidhānam; paramāṇurūpasya manasaḥ cakṣurādyadhiṣṭhāyakatvā'nupapatteḥ
anekaraśmirūpaṃ hi cakṣuḥ pārthivādyavayavasvabhāvañca ghrāṇādi, tat ki manasā yugapad adhiṣṭhīyate, krameṇa vā ? tatrādyapakṣo'nupapanna, ekaparamāṇurūpeṇa anena yugapadanekā'dhiṣṭhānā'nupapatte
yad ekaparamāṇurūpa na tad yugapadanekā'dhiṣṭhātṛ yathā ekaparamāṇuḥ, tadrūpañca bhavatkalpitaṃ mana iti

āśusañcāritvāt kramapratītāvapi yugapatpratītibhrama, ityapyapeśalam; avayavipratīterapi bhrāntitvaprasaṅgāt, anekasminnapi hi purovarttinyarthe krameṇa ekaikaraśmijanitaṃ jñānaṃ krameṇa ekaikameva arthagṛhṇīyāt, yugapadakhilā'vayaveṣu ekākārā pratītistu bhrāntā syāt, dhattūrakapuṣpavad ādau sūkṣmāṇāmapi ante mahattvam iti ca vighaṭeta, nahi kramapravṛttaparamāṇūnāṃ tathātvaṃ dṛṣṭam

kramabhāve'pi āśuvṛttyā tajjñānānāṃ yaugapadyapratītiḥ; ityapyacāru; nikhi labhāvānāṃ kṣaṇikatvaprasaṅgāt akṣaṇikatvādhyavasāyasya sarvatra āśuvṛttipravṛttatvāt, pratyakṣabādhā ubhayatra tulyā

abhivyaktā cet; kutastadabhivyaktiḥ–tatkarmabhedāt, anyato vā ? na tāvadanyataḥ; vijātīyavyaktīnāmabhivyañjakatve karkādibhyo gotvā'bhivyaktiprasaṅgāt

kiñca, āsāṃ tatkarmakṣaṇo vyañjakaḥ, tatsamudāyo vā ? na tāvat tatkṣaṇaḥ; prathamakṣaṇe samutpannasya tatkarmakṣaṇamātrasya durlakṣyatayā utkṣepaṇatvādijātyabhivyañjakatvā'yogāt, nahi kṣaṇamātrabhāvi karma utkṣepaṇam apakṣepaṇaṃ vā asmadādibhirlakṣyate, yena ataḥ tajjātibhedo'bhivyaktaḥ syāt, tasya atisūkṣmatvena yogināmeva pratyakṣatvāt
nāpi tatsamudāyo vyañjakaḥ; karmaṇāṃ kṣaṇikatvena samudāyasyaivā'saṃbhavāt

nanu dravya-guṇa-karmā'nimittā'bādhyamānā'nugatajñānanimittaṃ sāmānyam, tatsvarūpasya cāsya kathaṃ vicāryamāṇasyā'nupapattiḥ ? tadrūpatayā'sya pratyakṣādigocaracāritayā samarthayiṣyamāṇatvāt

tatra paraṃ mahāviṣayaṃ sattākhyam, tacca samasteṣu dravyaguṇakarmasu anuvṛttipratyayasyaiva hetutvāt sāmānyameva, na viśeṣaḥ

na ca iha grāme vṛkṣā iti ihedampratyayahetunā antarālā'bhāvena anekānta; sambandhagrahaṇāt
nāpi iha ākāśe śakuniḥ iti pratyayahetunā saṃyogena; ādhārādheyabhūtānām ityukteḥ, nahi ākāśasya vyāpitvena adhastādeva bhāvo'sti; śakuneḥ uparyapi bhāvāt
nāpi iha kuṇḍe dadhi iti pratyayahetunā; ayutasiddhā nām ityabhidhānāt, dadhikuṇḍādayaśca yutasiddhāḥ
yutasiddhiśca pṛthagāśrayavṛttitvaṃ pṛthaggatigattvañca ucyate
na cāsau tantupaṭādipu asti tantūn vihāya paṭasya anyatrā'vṛtteḥ
na ca iha ākāśe vācye vācakaḥ ākāśaśabdaḥ iti vācyavācakabhāvena iha ātmani jñānam iti viṣaya-viṣayibhāvena ca vyabhicāraḥ, atra ayutasiddheḥ ādhārādheyabhāvasya ca bhāvādityabhidhātavyam; ubhayatra avadhāraṇāśrayaṇāt, anayośca yutasiddheṣu anādhārādheyabhūteṣvapi ca bhāvāt ghaṭa-tacchabda-jñānavat

samānadharmasya sthāṇupuruṣayorūrdhvatālakṣaṇasya upapatteḥ upalabdheḥ
sa ca samāno dharma upalabhyamāno na kevalaḥ saṃśayahetuḥ kintu upalabdhyanupalabdhyavyavasthāto viśeṣāpekṣa, upalabdhyanupalabdhya vyavasthāto viśeṣāṃśe sādhaka-bādhakapramāṇā'bhāvāt viśeṣāpekṣaḥ sthāṇurvā puruṣo vā iti vimarśaḥ saṃśayaḥ
tathā, samānajātīyam asamānajātīyañca anekam, anekasmād vyāvṛtto dharmaḥ anekadharmaḥ, tadupapatteḥ upalabdhyanupalabdhyavyavasthāto viśeṣāpekṣaḥ saṃśayaḥ, yathā śabde vibhāgajatvadarśanāt kimayaṃ guṇo dravyaṃ karma vā iti ? nahi vibhāgajatvaṃ sajātīye kvacid guṇe vijātīye vā dravye karmaṇi ca varttate, ataḥ saṃśayahetuḥ–kibhūtasya asya vibhāgajatvamiti
tathā, vipratipatteḥ upalabdhyanupalabdhyavyavasthāto viśeṣāpekṣaḥ saṃśayaḥ, yathā asti ātmā ityeke, nāstyātmā ityapare, na ca sadbhāvā'sadbhāvau samamekatra bhavataḥ tasmāttattvā'navadhāraṇam asti ātmā, nāsti vā iti saṃśayaḥ
saṃśayo nāma sandehalakṣaṇānusandigdheṣvartheṣu aniścaya

tatra sādharmya-vaidharmyasamayorlakṣaṇam–sādharmya-vaidharmyābhyāmupasaṃhāre taddharmaviparyayopapatteḥ sādharmya-vaidharmyasamau
nyāyasū॰ 5
1
2 sādharmyeṇa vaidharmyeṇa vā sādhanamabhidhāya sisādhayiṣitapakṣopasaṃhāre sādhanavādinā kṛte sādhyadharmaviparyayopapādanāya sādharmyeṇa pratyavasthānaṃ sādharmyasamaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ
yathā anityaḥ śabdaḥ prayatnānantarīyakatvāt, yat prayatnānantarīyakaṃ tadanityam yathā ghaṭaḥ iti sādharmyeṇa hetau prayukte jātivādī sādharmyeṇaiva pratyavatiṣṭhate–nityaḥ śabdaḥ niravayavatvāt, yanniravayavaṃ tat nityaṃ dṛṣṭam yathā ākāśam iti, na cātra viśeṣaheturasti ghaṭasādharmyāt prayatnānantarīyakatvād anitya śabdaḥ na ca ākāśasādharmyāt niravayavatvāt nitya iti
vaidharmyeṇa vā pratyavatiṣṭhate–nityaḥśabdo niravayavatvāt, yat punaranityaṃ tat sāvayavaṃ dṛṣṭam yathā ghaṭa, na cāsti viśeṣahetuḥ ghaṭasādharmyāt prayatnānantarīyakatvāt anitya śabda na puna ghaṭavaidharmyāt niravayavatvāt nitya iti
sādharmyeṇopasaṃhāre sādhyadharmaviparyayopapatte sādharmyeṇaiva pratyavasthānamaviśiṣyamāṇaṃ sthāpanāhetutaḥ sādharmyasamaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ
atha sādharmyasama–kriyāvān loṣṭha kriyāhetuguṇayukto dṛṣṭa tathā cātmā tasmāt kriyāvān iti, na cāsti viśeṣahetu kriyāvadvaidharmyāt niṣkriyo na puna kriyāvatsādharmyāt kriyāvāniti viśeṣahetvabhāvāt sādharmyasama
nyāyabhā॰, bā॰ 5

2 pratijñāsiddhaye vādinā sādhane abhihite prativādinā ca tatra dūṣaṇe, tṛtīye vacasi varttamāno vādī yadi pratidṛṣṭāntadharma svadṛṣṭānte anujānāti tadā asya pratijñā hīyate iti pratijñāhāniḥ
yathā anitya śabdaḥ aindriyakatvāt ghaṭavat ityukte paraḥ pratyavatiṣṭhate– sāmānyam aindriyakaṃ nityaṃ dṛṣṭam ityanaikāntiko'yaṃ hetu ityukte sādhanavādī āha–yadi sāmānyam aindriyakaṃ nityam, kāmaṃ ghaṭo'pi tathāstu iti
sādhyadharmapratyanīkena dharmeṇa pratyavasthite pratidṛṣṭāntadharma svadṛṣṭānte abhyanujānan pratijñā jahā tīti pratijñāhāni

2
bhāṣyakārīyavyākhyāne vārtikakārasya matabheda, tathāhi– etattu na buddhyāmahe kathamatra pratijñā hīyate iti ? hetoranaikāntikatvaṃ sāmānyadṛṣṭāntena pareṇa codite tasyānaikāntikadoṣoddhāramanuktvā svadṛṣṭānte nityatā pratipadyate
nityatāpratipatteścāsiddhatā dṛṣṭāntadoṣo bhavati, so'ya dṛṣṭāntadoṣeṇa sādhanadoṣeṇa vā nigraho na pratijñāhāni
katha tarhi idaṃ sūtram–pratidṛṣṭāntadharmābhyanujñā svadṛṣṭānte pratijñāhāniriti ? dṛṣṭaścāsau ante vyavasthitaśca iti dṛṣṭānta, svaścāsau dṛṣṭāntaśceti, svadṛṣṭāntaśabdena pakṣa eva abhidhīyate
pratidṛṣṭāntaśabdena ca pratipakṣa, pratipakṣaścāsau dṛṣṭāntaśceti

kutaḥ etat ? ityatrāha–nā'ntarvahirvā ityādi
svalakṣaṇaṃ saugatakalpitam sāmānyalakṣaṇaṃ brahmādyadvaitavādi-sāṃkhyaparikalpitam prameyam, na iti sambandhaḥ
kva ? antarvahirvā
tarhi yaugakalpitaṃ tat prameyaṃ syādityatrāha–parasparā'nātmakam
anyonyamatyantabhinnam svalakṣaṇaṃ sāmānyalakṣaṇaṃ vā na prameyam iti sambandhaḥ
kathaṃ na prameyam ? ityāha– yathā ityādi
yathā yena prakāreṇa manyate paraiḥ iti
tarhi bhedā'bhedaikāntavyatirekeṇa anyasya asaṃbhavānna kiñcit prameyaṃ syādityatrāha–dravya ityādi
dravyaparyāyau uktalakṣaṇau ātmā svabhāvaḥ yasya arthasya tasya buddhau pratyakṣādipratītau pratibhāsanāt sa eva asyāḥ prameyaḥ siddhaḥ
dravyaparyāyau atyantaṃ bhinnau bhinnapratibhāsatvāt ityādinā sarvathā bhedamupavarṇayato yaugasya pūrvapakṣa–
nanu dravyaparyāyayoḥ bhinnapratibhāsatvādinā anyonyamatyantaṃ bhinnatvāt kathaṃ tadātmāpyarthaḥ prameyaḥ syāt ? tathāhi–dravyaparyāyau atyantaṃ bhinnau bhinnapratibhāsatvāt ghaṭapaṭādivat
ghaṭapaṭādau hi bhinnapratibhāsatvamatyantabhede satyeva upalabdham, tad dravyaparyāyayorupalabhyamānaṃ kathannātyantabhedaṃ prasādhayet ? anyatrāpyasya tadaprasādhakatvaprasaṅgāt
na cānayorbhinnapratibhāsatvamasiddham; tantvādidravyapratibhāsasya paṭādiparyāyapratibhāsavailakṣaṇyena akhilaprāṇināṃ suprasiddhatvāt
tathā viruddhadharmādhyāsato'pi anayo jalā'nalavad bhedaḥ
nacānayoḥ tadadhyāso'siddhaḥ; paṭo hi paṭatvajātisambandhī vilakṣaṇārthakriyāsampādakaḥ atiśayena mahattvayukto'nubhūyate, tantavastu tantutvajātisambandhino'lpaparimāṇādidharmopetāśca, iti kathanna bhidyante ? tādātmyañca ekatvamucyate, tasmiṃśca sati pratibhāsabhedo viruddhadharmādhyāsaśca na prāpnoti vibhinnaviṣayatvāttayoḥ
tathā tantupaṭādīnāṃ tādātmye paṭa tantavaḥ iti saṃjñābhedaḥ, vacanabhedaḥ, paṭasya bhāvaḥ paṭatvam iti ṣaṣṭhī, taddhitotpattiśca na prāpnoti
tathā tattādātmye tatpuruṣa-bahuvrīhi-dvandasamāsā api na prāpnuvanti, sati hi bhede tatpuruṣo dṛṣṭaḥ yathā rājñaḥ puruṣaḥ evaṃ tantūnāṃ paṭaḥ iti, bahuvrīhiśca yathā citraguḥ evaṃ tantukāraṇakaḥ paṭaḥ iti, dvandaśca yathā plakṣa-nyagrodhau evaṃ tantupaṭau iti
–ntabhi– bhā॰

kiñca tādātmyam ityatra ki sa paṭaḥ ātmā yeṣāṃ tantūnām teṣāṃ bhāvaḥ tādātmyam iti vigrahaḥ, te vā tantavaḥ ātmā yasya paṭasya, sa ca te ca ātmā yasya iti vā ? tatra ādyavikalpe paṭasya ekatvāt tantūnāmapi ekatvaprasaṅgaḥ, anyathā tattādātmyā'nupapattiḥ
dvitīyavikalpe tu tantūnāmanekatvāt paṭasyāpi anekatvā'nuṣaṅgaḥ, anyathā tattādātmyaṃ na syāt
tṛtīyavikalpastu avicāritaramaṇīyaḥ; tadvyatiriktasya vastuno'saṃbhavāt, nahi tantu-paṭavyatiriktaṃ kiñcid vastvantaramasti yasya tantupaṭātmatā ucyate

bhāvā'bhāvātmakatvañca arthānāṃ chāyātapavad virodhād atīva durghaṭam

uttarapadārthe ca niścite sarvatra nañaḥ prayogaḥ abrāhmaṇādivat, ekāntaśca yadi kvacit niścitaḥ kathaṃ sarvamanekāntātmakaṃ syāt ?

tathā yatra abhedaḥ tatra bhedasya virodhaḥ, yatra ca bhedaḥ tatra abhedasya śītoṣṇasparśavat iti virodha
tathā abhedasya ekatvasvabhāvasya anyadadhikaraṇam bhedasyānekatvasvabhāvasya anyat iti vaiyadhikaraṇyam
tathā ekāntena ekātmakatve yo doṣaḥ anekasvabhāvatvā'bhāvalakṣaṇa, anekāntātmakatve ca ekasvabhāvatvā'bhāvalakṣaṇaḥ so'trāpyanuṣajyate ityubhayadoṣa
tathā yena svabhāvena arthasya ekasvabhāvatā tena anekasvabhāvatvasyāpi prasaṅga yena ca anekasvabhāvatā tena ekasvabhāvatvasyāpi iti saṅkaraprasaṅga

sāvyavahārika śābda jñāna śrutamityapekṣayā tathāniyame tu neṣṭabādhā'sti cakṣurādimatipūrvakasyāpi śrutasya paramārthato'bhyupagamāt svasamayapratipatte

pakṣadharmatvādirūpatrayasya liṅgalakṣaṇatvavyudāsapurassaraṃ tasya avinābhābaikalakṣaṇatvasamarthanam–
nanu liṅgasya sādhyāvinābhāvaikalakṣaṇatvamayuktam, tasya pakṣadharmatvādilakṣaṇatrayānvitatvena ekalakṣaṇatvāyogāt

nahi pakṣadharmatvābhāve asya asiddhatvavyavacchedaḥ, sapakṣe sattvābhāve ca viruddhatvavyudāsa, vipakṣe'sattvābhāve ca anaikāntikatvaniṣedhaḥ karttuṃ śakya iti
uktañca–
hetustrirūpa
kiṃ punastrairūpyam ? pakṣadharmatvam, sapakṣe sattvam, vipakṣe cāsattvamiti
–nyāyaprave॰ pṛ॰ 1
trairūpya punaḥ liṅgasyānumeye sattvameva, anumeya vakṣyamāṇalakṣaṇam, tasmilligasya sattvameva niścitameka rūpam, tatra sattvavacanena asiddha cākṣuṣatvādi nirastam
evakāreṇa pakṣaikadeśā- siddho nirasto hetu, yathā cetanāstarava svāpāt iti
pakṣīkṛteṣutaruṣu patrasaṃkocalakṣaṇa svā pa ekadeśena siddha
na hi sarve vṛkṣā rātrau patrasaṃkocabhāja, kintu kecideva
sattvavacanasya paścātkṛtena evakāreṇa asādhāraṇo dharmo nirastaḥ
yadi hi anurmeya eva sattvamiti kuryāt śrāvaṇatvameva hetu syāt
niścitagrahaṇena sandigdhāsiddha sarvo nirasta
sapakṣaeva sattvam, sapakṣo vakṣyamāṇalakṣaṇa, tasminneva sattvaṃ niścitaṃ dvitīyaṃ rūpam
ihāpi sattvagrahaṇena viruddho nirasta, sa hi nāsti sapakṣe
evakāreṇa sādhāraṇānaikāntika, anitya śabda prameyatvāt, sa hi na sapakṣa eva vartate kintūbhayatrāpi
sattvagrahaṇāt pūrvāvadhāraṇavacanena sapakṣavyāpisattākasyāpi prayatnānantarīyakasya hetutvaṃ kathitam
paścādavadhāraṇe tvayamartha syāt–sapakṣe sattvameva yasya sa heturiti prayatnānantarīyaka na hetu syāt
niścitavacanena sandigdhānvayo'naikāntiko nirasta, yathā sarvajñaḥ kaścid vaktṛtavāt, vaktṛtvaṃ hi sapakṣe sarvajñe sandigdham
asapakṣe cāsattvameva niścitam, asapakṣo vakṣyamāṇalakṣaṇa, tasmin asattvameva niścitaṃ tṛtīya rūpam
tatrāsattvagrahaṇena viruddhasya nirāsa, viruddho hi vipakṣe'sti
evakāreṇa sādhāraṇasya vipakṣaikadeśavṛtternirāsa, nitya śabda kṛtakatvāt khavat
prayatnānantarīyakatve sādhye hi anityatva vipakṣaikadeśe vidyudādāvasti ākāśādau nāsti tato niyamenāsya nirāsa
asattvavacanāt pūrvasminnavadhāraṇe'yamarthaḥ syāt–vipakṣe eva yo nāsti sa hetu
tathā ca prayatnānantarīyakatvaṃ sapakṣe'pi sarvatra nāsti tato na hetu syāt, tata pūrvaṃ na kṛtam
niścitagrahaṇena sandigdhavipakṣavyāvṛttiko'naikāntiko nirasta

vivṛtivyākhyānam–
adṛśya ityādinā vyatirekamukhena kārikāṃ vyācaṣṭe–adṛśyānupalabdheḥ sakāśāt saṃśayaikānte aṅgīkriyamāṇe na kevalaṃ paricittābhāvo na siddhyati saugatasya api tu svacittabhāvaśca na siddhyati
kuta etad ? ityatrāha–tad ityādi
tasya svacittasya yad anaśaṃ tattvaṃ sajātīryavijātīyavyāvṛttaṃ madhyakṣaṇasvarūpaṃ tasya adṛśyātmakatvāt
tataḥ kiṃ jātam ? ityatrāha tathā ca ityādi
tathā ca tena ca svacittabhāvā'siddhiprakāreṇa kutaḥ na kutaścit paramārthasato mānād bhāvasya kṣaṇabhaṅgasiddhiḥ dharmihetudṛṣṭāntāderasiddhe
na khalu bahirantarvā anaṃśatattvasya adṛśyātmatayā'siddhau dharmyādeḥ siddhiryuktā, tadasiddhau ca kutaḥ kṣaṇabhaṅgādeḥ siddhiḥ syāt ? kasya tarhi kṣaṇabhaṅgasiddhiḥ syāt ? ityāha–tad ityādi
tasmād anaṃśatattvād viparītaṃ sāśaṃ tattvaṃ tasya
kathambhūtasya ? abhedalakṣaṇasya yugapat krameṇa vā anekasvabhāvātmakasya syād bhavet kṣaṇabhaṅgasiddhiḥ nānyasya iti evakārārthaḥ

vīkṣyamupalabdhilakṣaṇaprāpta sthūla tasyāṇava sūkṣmā bhāgā avayavāsteṣā pārimāṇḍalyaṃ vartulatvam anyonyavivekaḥ kṣaṇe kṣaṇe bhaṅga kṣaṇabhaṅgaḥ samaya prati nāśa ityartha

na khalu sāvyavahārikapratyakṣeṇa kṣaṇabhaṅgādirvīkṣyate tena sthirasthūlasādhāraṇākārasyaiva vīkṣaṇāt, yogipratyakṣasyaiva tadvīkṣaṇasāmarthyādityartha, sattvātprameyatvādarthakriyākāritvādityādihetūnā kathañcidanekānityādidharmavyāpyatvāttadavinābhāvaprasiddhe

yathā jñānasya svarūpapratibhāsane bahirarthākāranivṛttirvidyamānenāpi na pratibhāsate saugatānā tasya tādṛk sāmarthyābhāvāt tathā vahirantaścāṇupārimāṇḍalyādi pratyakṣeṇa na pratibhāsate tathāśaktyabhāvāt

vivṛtivyākhyānam–
kārikārthaṃ vivṛṇvannāha–sthūlasya ityādi
sthūlasya mahataḥ ekasya kramā'kramānekavivarttavyāpina pratipāditaprakāreṇa dṛśyātmana eva upalabhyasvabhāvasyaiva anityatvaṃ siddhyati nānyasya iti sambandhaḥ
kuta etat ? anupalambhāt hetoḥ tasyaiva pūrvāparākārakoṭyoḥ abhāvasiddheḥ
tathā ca yaduktaṃ pareṇa–yad yatra upalabdhilakṣaṇaprāpta sannopalabhyate tat tatra nāsti yathā kvacit pradeśaviśepe ghaṭaḥ, nopalabhyate ca upalabdhilakṣaṇaprāpto madhyakṣaṇaḥ pūrvāparakoṭyoḥ iti; tadayuktam, yataḥ kathañcittatra tadabhāvasādhane siddhasādhanam
sarvathā tatsādhane pakṣasya pratyakṣavādhanaṃ hetoścā'siddhiḥ, tathā tatra tadanupalambhā'siddheriti
nanu cāstu sthūlādisvabhāvasyārthasya anityatvaṃ na tu paramārthasatvam marīcikājalādivadasattvāt, ityāśaṅkyāha–buddheḥ ityādi
yathoktasyaivārthasya paramārthasattvaṃ buddhervedyavedakākāraprabhedasya iva
prayogaḥ–yad anekasvabhāvaṃ tadeva paramārthasat yathā vedyavedakādyanekasvabhāvā saṃvit, anekasvabhāvañca antarvahirvā jainābhyupagataṃ vastu iti
tathāpi marīcikātoyanidarśanena asyā'sattve buddherapyato'sattvaprasaṅga viśeṣābhāvāt
nanu nā'nekasvabhāvasyārthasya anityatvaṃ paramārthasattvaṃ vā api tu paramāṇvāde, ityatrāha–napunaḥ ityādi
na punaḥ naiva parimaṇḍalasambandhāt parimaṇḍalaḥ paramāṇuḥ ādiryasya yaugakalpitā'vayavyādeḥ sa tathoktaḥ tasyā'nityatvaṃ paramārthasattvañca
nidarśanamāha– vijñāna ityādi
vijñānasya yad anaṃśaṃ tattvaṃ svarūpaṃ tasya iva tadvaditi
nanu bahirantaśca anaṃśasyaiva tattvasya upalambhaḥ atastasyaiva paramārthasattvam, anupalambhācca pūrvāparakoṭyorasattvaṃ siddhyati iti yauga-saugatāḥ; tatrāha–nāpi ityādi
nāpi naiva kṣaṇikāḥ parimaṇḍalāḥ paramāṇavaḥ ādayo yasya avayavyādeḥ sa tathoktaḥ tasya avibhāgavijñānatattvasya vā jātucit kadācidapi svayam ātmanā upalabdhiḥ
kuta etadityatrāha–tathaiva ityādi
tathaiva paraparikalpitaprakāreṇaiva apratibhāsanāt
atha bahirantastattvasya kṣaṇikā'naṃśādisvabhāvatayā apratibhāsane'pi saccetanādirūpatayā pratibhāsanādayamadoṣaḥ; atrāha–tatkathañcid ityādi
tasya bahirantastattvasya kathañcit na sarvātmanā tatsvabhāvapratibhāse saccetanādisvarūpapratibhāsane aṅgīkriyamāṇe anekāntasiddhiḥ ekasya dṛśyetarasvabhāvasiddheḥ

na ca vilakṣaṇasāmagrīprabhavaṃ jñānaṃ pratyabhijñānaṃ yuktamatiprasaṅgāt; ityapyasāmpratam; atrāpi tatsāmagryā vidyamānatvāt
tathāhi–smaraṇāpekṣaṃ gavayapratyakṣam evaṃvidhaṃ jñānamupajanayati, anapekṣaṃ vā ? tatra anapekṣasya janakatve aprasiddhagopiṇḍasyāpi etat syāt
atha smaraṇāpekṣaṃ janakatvam, tatrāpi kiṃ smaraṇamātrāpekṣam, gopiṇḍasmaraṇāpekṣa vā tattajjanayet ? yadi smaraṇamātrāpekṣam, tadā aśvādismaraṇe'pi tat tajjanayet
atha gopiṇḍasmaraṇāpekṣam, tatrāpi kiṃ gopiṇḍasmṛtimātrāpekṣam, sādṛśyāvacchinnagopiṇḍasmaraṇāpekṣa vā ? prathamapakṣe mahiṣyādismaraṇe'pi tasya tajjanakatvaprasaṅgaḥ, sādṛśyāpratipatteḥ ubhayatrāpyaviśeṣāt
gavayasādṛśyāvacchinnagopiṇḍasmaraṇāpekṣitve tu siddha pūrvameva sādṛśyānunubhava, tadasiddhau saṃskāraviśeṣābhāvataḥ tatsmaraṇasyaivā'nupapatteḥ
pūrvaṃ tadananubhave ca gopiṇḍasaṃsthānaviśeṣaviṣayaṃ nipuṇanirūpaṇamanarthakameva syāt
piṇḍamātrasmaraṇe'pi sannikṛṣṭasādṛśyadarśanabalena viprakṛṣṭasādṛśyapratīterutpādaprasaṅgāt
na ca piṇḍamātrāmanusmarataḥ saṃsthānaviśeṣamanirūpayataḥ sādṛśyapratītirutpadyate
ato manyāmahe–gavayasādṛśyāvacchinnagopiṇḍānubhavabhāviteyaṃ smṛtiriti
tathāvidhasmṛtisahāyañca gavayapratyakṣam anena sadṛśo gauḥ iti jñānamutpādayatīti siddhamasya smṛtipratyakṣaprabhavatvam
ataḥ nopamānaṃ pratyabhijñānād bhidyate, abhinnasāmagrīprabhavatvāt, yadabhinnasāmagrīprabhavaṃ tadabhinnam yathā avinābhāvalakṣaṇalakṣitahetutaḥ samupajāyamānaṃ kāryasvabhāvādyanumānam, smṛtipratyakṣalakṣaṇā'bhinnasāmagrīprabhavañca pratyabhijñānopamānalakṣaṇaṃ jñānadvayamiti
tulanā–tatra kiṃ smaraṇāpekṣamindriyameva jñāna janayati anapekṣa veti ? anapekṣasya jñānajanakatve aprasiddhagopiṇḍasya smaraṇe'pyetat syāt
atha piṇḍamātrasmaraṇe, aśvādipiṇḍasmaraṇe syāt
atha gavayasādṛśyāvacchinnasmaraṇāpekṣa janakam, tatrāpi yadi smaraṇamātramapekṣeta, gajādismaraṇe'pi syāt
atha gopiṇḍasmaraṇāpekṣam, tatrāpi kiṃ gopiṇḍamātrasmaraṇamapekṣate, gavayasādṛśyāvacchinna gopiṇḍasmaraṇa veti ? gopiṇḍamātrasmaraṇe aśvādipiṇḍasmaraṇe'pi syāt
gavayādisādṛśyāvacchinnagopiṇḍasmaraṇāpekṣitve pūrvamevānubhavo vācya, tadantareṇa saskārānutpatte smaraṇasyaivābhāvāt
ata savikalpajñānābhāve'pi gavayasādṛśyāvacchinne gopiṇḍe pūrvamanubhavo'bhyupagantavya
yena hi saṃskārotpattau smaraṇānmadīyayā gavā sadṛśo'ya gavaya iti jñāna syāt
pūrvaṃ ca gavayasādṛśyāvacchinnagopiṇḍe'nubhavaprasiddhau gavayopalambhāt madīyā gauranena sadṛśī iti kathametat smaraṇa na syāt ? tathā pṛṣṭo bravīti etatsadṛśī mayopalabdhā na tu pramāṇāntara nirdiśati

atha dṛṣṭena adṛṣṭasiddheḥ anumānameveyamityucyate, tanna, tatsāmagryabhāvāt

tathāhi–bahirbhāvaviśiṣṭe caitre caitraviśiṣṭe vā bahirbhāve anumeye kasya hetutvam–kiṃ gṛhābhāvaviśiṣṭasya caitrasya, caitrābhāvaviśiṣṭasya vā gṛhasya, gṛhe caitrābhāvasya vā, gṛhe caitrādarśanasya vā ? tatra naiteṣāṃ madhye anyatamo'pi heturghaṭate; pakṣadharmatvābhāvāt
nahyete caitradharmāḥ tadbahirbhāvadharmā vā

kārikārtha–
kālādīnāṃ bhedāt śabdaḥ śabdanayaḥ arthasya jīvādeḥ bhedaṃ karoti pratipādayati iti tadbhedakṛt
abhirūḍhanayaḥ punaḥ paryāyaiḥ paryāyaśabdaiḥ arthabhedakṛt

vivṛtivyākhyānam–
kārikāṃ vivṛṇvannāha kāla ityādi
tāvacchabdaḥ kramavācī, kālabhedāt kālaviśeṣād arthabhedastāvadudāhriyate–abhūt atītakālasambandhyanubhavādiparyāyātmanā jīvādiḥ, bhavati varttamānakālasambandhismaraṇādiparyāyarūpeṇa jāyate
hetuhetumadbhāvaścātra draṣṭavyaḥ–yasmād bhavati tasmād abhūta, pariṇāmyupādānakāraṇamantareṇa bhavati ityasyāyogāt

kārikārtha–
kāryakāraṇayoścāpi ityapiśabdaḥ sannidheḥ ityasyānantaraṃ draṣṭavyaḥ, tato'yamartho jāyate–na kevalamarthasya kintu sannidherapi sannikarṣasyāpi buddhiradhyavasāyinī
keṣāṃ tasya ityāha–indriyārthānām
tathā anvayavyatirekayoḥ sannidherbhāvābhāvayo buddhiḥ adhyavasāyinī
na kevalamanayoḥ apitu kāryakāraṇayośca, kārya sannikarṣaḥ kāraṇam indriyādi
yadi vā, kārya jñānam, kāraṇaṃ sannikarṣa tayośca buddhiradhyavasāyinī
etaduktaṃ bhavati–sannikarṣādisadbhāve'pi yāvad buddhirnotpadyate tāvattasya tadanvayavyatirekayoḥ tatkāryakāraṇabhāvasya anyasya vā na vyavasthā, buddhikalpanāvaiphalyaprasaṅgāt
utpannāyāṃ tu tasyām anyāpekṣāmantareṇaiva tattvavyavastheti, ataḥ saiva sādhakatamatvāt pramāṇaṃ na sannikarṣādi

yatkutaścijjñātunna śakyate na tat jñānotpattau kāraṇatvena prekṣāvatā aṅgīkarttavyam yathā kharaviṣāṇam, kutaścidapi pramāṇāt jñātunna śakyate ca sannikarṣādiriti
yathā cāsau kutaścidapi pramāṇāt jñātumaśakyaḥ tathā pratyakṣaparicchede prapañcataḥ pratipāditam
bhavatkalpitaśca ātmā mana indriyamarthaśca niraṃśādirūpo yathā nopapadyate tathā viṣayaparicchede saprapañcaṃ prapañcitam
ataḥ kasya kena sannikarṣaḥ syāt ?

kairdharmaiḥ ityāha–jñānadarśanavīryasukhaiḥ
nanu darśanameva puruṣasya svarūpaṃ na jñānādayaḥ, teṣāṃ prakṛtidharmatvāt tatkathaṃ tairasau anekāntaḥ ? ityapyayuktam, prakṛtidharmatāṃ nirākṛtya teṣāṃ taddharmatāyāḥ pratyakṣaparicchede pratipāditatvāt
tataḥ sūktam–jñānādibhiḥ jīvo'nekāntaḥ iti
kathambhūtaistaiḥ ityāha–asādhāraṇaiḥ pudgalādyasaṃbhavibhiḥ
nanu buddhyādayo nava ātmano'sādhāraṇā guṇāḥ santi tatkimarthamete catvāra eva darśitāḥ iti cet ? teṣāmeva sahabhuvāṃ tadguṇatvapratipādanārtham

kiṃ viśiṣṭaiḥ sādhāraṇāsādhāraṇaiḥ, sādhāraṇaiḥ gaganādāvapi bhāvāt, asādhāraṇaiḥ pudgaleṣvabhāvāt

tathā, deśakālādibhinnā gośabdavyaktibuddhayaḥ ekagośabdaviṣayā na cānekārthagocarā gaurityutpadyamānatvāt sampratyutpannagośabdabuddhivat
gośabdavyaktibuddhayaḥ ityucyamāne siddhasādhyatā syāt, ekagośabdavyaktibuddheḥ ekaviṣayatvābhyupagamāt, tannivṛttyarthaṃ bahuvacanam
tathā sāmānye gośabdanibandhanāḥ samānā evaṃ dhiyaḥ prabhavanti iti tannirāsārthaṃ vyaktigrahaṇam
ekasmin deśe kāle vā bahūnāṃ pramātṝṇāṃ gośabdajñānāni ekagośabdavyaktigocarāṇi iti siddhasādhyatāprasaṅgavyavacchedārthaṃ deśakālādibhinnāḥ ityuktam
hyastano vā gośabdaḥ adyāpyanuvarttate gauriti jñāyamānatvāt adyoccāritagośabdavat

teṣāṃ tatkā– ā॰

antyavarṇakāle
kiñca, saṃvedanaprabhavasaṃskārāḥ svotpādakasaṃvedanaviṣaye smṛtihetavaḥ na tu arthāntare jñānamutpādayituṃ samarthāḥ
na khalu ghaṭajñānaprabhavaḥ saṃskāraḥ paṭe smṛtiṃ vidadhat dṛṣṭaḥ
na ca tatsaṃskāraprabhavasmṛtīnāṃ tatsahāyatā yuktā; tāsāṃ yugapadutpattyabhāvāt, ayugapadutpannānāñca avasthityasaṃbhavāt
na ca akhilasaṃskāraprabhavaikā smṛtiḥ saṃbhavati; anyonyaviruddhānekārthānubhavaprabhavasaṃskārāṇāmapi ekasmṛtijanakatvaprasaṅgāt
na ca anyavarṇānapekṣa eva gauḥ ityatra antyo varṇaḥ arthapratipādakaḥ; pūrvavarṇoccāraṇavaiyarthyānupaṅgāt, ghaṭaśabdāntyavyavasthitasyāpyasya kakudādimarthapratipādakatvaprasaṅgācca

ataḥ saṃskṛtetaravedināṃ vyavahārasya gāvyādiśabdaireva dṛṣṭatvātteṣāmeva anvayavyatirekābhyāṃ vācakatvamavadhāryate

na khalu prākṛtaśabdebhyaḥ prathamaṃ saṃskṛtaśabdasmaraṇa tato'rthapratītiḥ iti vyavadhānena arthapratyayo'nubhūyate, saṃskṛtaśabdavat tebhyo'pi sākṣādeva arthapratyayapratīteḥ, anyathā yatra saṃskṛtajñā na santi tatra bhāṣāśabdebhyo'rthapratyayo na syāt
tato gavādiśabdavat śabdāntarasmṛtinirapekṣatayaiva sadā teṣāmarthāvabodhakatvapratīteḥ vācakatvamevopapannam

apabhraṣṭatvañcāsya puruṣārthā'prasādhakatvāt, vyākaraṇasmṛtyanugṛhītasya sarvatra sarvadā'navacchinnasya ekatvena pratītyabhāvāt, saṅketena arthābhidhāyitvādvā syāt ? tatra ādyaḥ pakṣo'nupapannaḥ; sakalasya dharmārthādeḥ puruṣārthasya prākṛtaśabdavyavahārādeva prasiddheḥ
nahi kaścittādṛśaḥ puruṣārtho'sti yatra sākṣāt paramparayā vā tadvyavahāro na syāt
tatpratipipādayiṣayā prayuktānāmapi saṃskṛtaśabdānāmarthaḥ suspaṣṭaḥ prākṛtaśabdaireva pradarśyate iti kathaṃ tadvyavahārasya puruṣārthā'prasādhakatvaṃ yato'pabhraṣṭatvaṃ syāt ? dvitīyapakṣe tu ṭhakāgamasya sadhanaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ hanyād bhūtikāmaḥ ityādeḥ sādhutvaprasaṅgaḥ, vyākaraṇasmṛtyanugṛhītasya sarvatra sarvadānavacchinnasyaikatvena asyāpi pratītyaviśeṣāt
śiṣṭairasvīkṛtatvāt tatrāsya vicchedaḥ paśuvadhādyāgame'pi samānaḥ
nahi śvetamajamālabheta ityāgamaḥ parīkṣāpradhānaiḥ kṛpārdrīkṛtacetovṛttibhiḥ ādriyate
tṛtīyapakṣopyayuktaḥ; prākṛtaśabdavat saṃskṛtaśabdānāmapi saṅketasahāyānāmeva arthapratipādanasāmarthyasaṃbhavāt
asaṅketitā'nabhitābhidhāne atiprasaṅgāt
tadevaṃ saṃskṛtetaraśabdānāṃ viśeṣāsaṃbhavāt ubhayeṣāṃ sādhutvamasādhutvaṃ vā aviśeṣataḥ pratipattavyam

–tattvo॰ pṛ॰ 124
anādiprayogitāpi pravāhāpekṣayā, nityatvāpekṣayā vā ucyeta ? prathamapakṣe gogāvīśabdayoraviśeṣaḥ, dvayorapi anādiprayogitāyā tathā saṃbhavād ubhayorapi sādhutvamasādhutvaṃ vā'viśeṣataḥ syāt

pramāṇānām adhyakṣādīnāṃ yā pramāṇatā saugatādibhiriṣyate sā vyavahārānukūlyādeva upapannā nānyathā, anyathā vyavahāraprātikūlyaprakāreṇa na, kuta etat ? ityatrāha–bādhyamāna ityādi

tapasā yathākhyātacāritralakṣaṇena nirjīrṇāni nirmūlonmīlitāni karmāṇi yenāsau tathoktaḥ
punarapi kathambhūtaḥ sannasau vimuktaḥ syāt ityāha–jīvasthāna ityādi
pratyekaṃ caturdaśabhiḥ jīvasthānaiḥ guṇasthānaiḥ mārgaṇāsthānaiśca tattvavit jīvādisvarūpavit
punarapi kiṃviśiṣṭaḥ sannasau vimuktaḥ syāt ? ityāha–vivṛddha ityādi
viśeṣeṇa vṛddhaṃ kṣāyikarūpatayā paramaprakarṣaṃ prāptam abhiniveśanaṃ samyagdarśanaṃ yasya sa tathoktaḥ
vivṛddhābhinive śataḥ iti kvacit pāṭhaḥ
tatrāyamarthaḥ–vivṛddhā'bhiniveśato'yamātmā jīvāditattvavit taponirjīrṇakarmā ca bhavati samyagdarśanapūrvakatvāt samyagjñānacāritrayoriti
anena ca granthena vimukteḥ samyagdarśanajñānacāritrātmikā sāmagrī prarūpitā bhavati, tadanyatamasyāpyapāye tasyā anupapadyamānatvāt
tadanupapadyamānatvañca atraiva anantaraṃ pratipādayiṣyate
kiṃ kṛttvā'sau vivṛddhābhiniveśanaḥ tattvavicca ityāha–anuyujya ityādi
anuyogaśabdaḥ praśne prativacane ca pravarttate, tadyathā kṛtānuyogo'pi bhavānna kiñcid bravīti tūṣṇīmādāya sthitaḥ ityatra anuyogaśabdaḥ praśne prasiddhaḥ

guṇāḥ jñānādayaḥ guṇī cittasantānaḥ teṣāṃ vināśād atyantocchedāt ātmā śūnyaḥ sakalasvarūpavivikto bhavati nahi iti sambandhaḥ
bhogyavirahāt tadā draṣṭuḥ svarūpe'vasthānād abhoktā ātmā sukhādeḥ nahi iti sambandha

yathaiva hi andho darśanaśaktivikalaḥ tacchaktiyuktapaṅgūpadeśamantareṇa neṣṭapradeśamupasarpati, paṅgurapi kriyāśaktiśūnyaḥ tacchaktiyuktā'ndhasaṃsargādvinā iti, tathā pradhānaṃ nāntareṇa puruṣaṃ kṛtamapi kāryaṃ draṣṭuṃ kṣamam, puruṣo'pi satyapi caitanye pradhānaṃ vinā dṛśyābhāvānna draṣṭā syāt

tathā cātisundaramapi antavad dunoti tena tadapi heyameva vivekina

atha nityam; tadā muktetarāvasthayoraviśeṣaprasaṅgaḥ, sukhatatsaṃvedanayoḥ nityatvena ubhayatra sadbhāvā'viśeṣāt
indriyajasukhena cāsya saṃsārāvasthāyāṃ sāhacaryānubhavaprasaṅgāt sukhadvayopalambhaḥ syāt
pratibaddhatvāttadā tasyā'nupalambha iti cet, kenāsya pratibaddhatvam–śarīreṇa, avidyayā, vaipayikasukhādyanubhavena, bāhyaviṣayavyāsaṅgena vā ? na tāvat śarīreṇa, asya sukhasādhakatvena tatpratibandhakatvāyogāt
nahi yad yadarthaṃ tat tasyaiva pratibandhakam atiprasaṅgāt
pratibandhakaṃ hi kāryavighātakamucyate
na ca śarīraṃ sukhasya vighātakam tasmin sati tasya ātmalābhāt
yasmin sati yasyātmalābhaḥ na tat tasya pratibandhakam yathā bījamaṅkurasya, śarīre sati ātmalābhaśca sukhasyeti
tasya tatpratibandhakatve ca tadapahanturhisāphalaṃ na syāt, pratibandhavighātakasya upakārakatvena loke prasiddheḥ
nāpi avidyayā; tasyāḥ tuccharūpatayā tatpratibandhalakṣaṇārthakriyākāritvā'saṃbhavāt
yat tuccharūpaṃ na tadarthakriyākāri yathā mṛgatṛṣṇikājalam, tuccharūpā ca avidyā bhavadbhiriṣṭā iti
pratiṣiddhañca avidyāyāḥ pratibandhakatvaṃ brahmādvaitapraghaṭṭake prapañcena ityalaṃ punaḥ prasaṅgena
nāpi vaiṣayikasukhādyanubhavena; tena hi nityasukhasya tadanubhavasya vā pratibandhaḥ anutpattilakṣaṇo vināśalakṣaṇo vā na yuktaḥ; dvayorapi nityatvābhyupagamāt
nāpi bāhyaviṣayavyāsaṅgena, tena hi pramātuḥ, indriyādervā sambandhinā tatpratibandhaḥ kriyate ? pakṣadvayamapyetadayuktam; ātmano hi pramāturvyāsaṅgaḥ rūpādau viṣaye jñānotpattau viṣayāntare jñānānutpattiḥ, indriyasyāpi ekasmin viṣaye jñānajanakatvena pravṛttasya viṣayāntare jñānā'janakatvam
sa cātra asambhāvyaḥ; sukhavat tajjñānasyāpi sadā sattvāt
tulanā– sukhavannityamiti cet, sasārasthasya muktenāviśeṣa, abhyanujñāne ca dharmādharmaphalena sāhacaryyaṃ yaugapadya gṛhyeta–yadidamutpattisthāneṣu dharmādharmaphala sukha duḥkha vā savedyate paryāyeṇa, tasya ca nityasaṃvedanasya ca sahabhāva yaugapadya gṛhyeta
na sukhābhāvaḥ nānabhivyaktirasti, ubhayasya nityatvāt

prārambhikamupādāya viśeṣādhijigāṃsayā
vidvatsundaramindūravidyālayamavāptavān || 3
baṃśīdharāt dharmamadhītya jīvandharācca tarkaṃ śramataḥ satarkam
syādvādavidyālayametya tasminnaśrāntamaśrāmyamahaṃ cirāya || 4
nyāyamadhyāpayannantevāsino'pi nirantaram
abhūvamuttamaśreṇyāṃ nyāyācāryastataḥ param || 5
gaveṣaṇāpūrṇadhiyeha ṭippaṇītihāsasamyaktulanā mayā śramāt
vilikhya tatrānavadhānadūṣaṇaṃ sudhījanaḥ śodhayitetyupekṣyate || 6
rasarasayuganetre vīranirvāṇavarṣe,
prathamadalanavamyāṃ bhaumavārānvitāyām
kṛtiriyamagamanme pūrṇatāṃ māsi bhādre,
gurucaraṇakṛpaughenāntareṇāntarāyam || 7
